commands.name: canceldemo
commands.code: async function main(argv, ctx) { for (let i = 0; i < 400; i += 1) { if (ctx.signal.aborted) { return; } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); } }

commands.name: outputdemo
commands.code: async function main(argv, ctx) { ctx.out.write('a'); ctx.out.write('b'); ctx.out.info({ l10n: { 'en-US': 'Hello', 'fr': 'Bonjour' }, data: { n: 1 } }); return 42; }
